name: BIOBUZZ
label: BIOBUZZ field (hive, flowers, pollen, nectar) — soft mechanisms bridged

driveFeel.note: Uses setTankPower + updateDriveSlew from BIOBUZZ teleop for matching feel

left.polarityNote: real robot: left drive inverted (leftDrive.setDirection(REVERSE)); sim maps via LEFT_DRIVE_SIGN

flywheel.mapping: Edge-trigger shoot when |power| crosses above threshold 0.3 (rising edge). Continuous high power does not re-fire until power drops ≤0.3.
flywheel.sensorNote: No MJCF joint — encoder reads stay 0; telemetry shows commanded power / last shoot

intakeMotor.mapping: power > 0.05 ⇒ achterintake aan (alleen gele POLLEN, naar de shooter-hopper; intakeLayout rearPollen); power < -0.05 ⇒ rear FIFO spit. Magnitude threshold 0.05.
intakeMotor.sensorNote: No MJCF joint — encoder reads stay 0

pollenServo.mapping: Rising edge when position01 crosses above 0.7 → FIFO rear → flower place (or drop). Shown in telemetry; no joint.

crServo.mapping: While |power| > 0.3, force rear FIFO eject (intakePower = -1), like hold C in teleop. Overrides intakeMotor while active.

initialPose.note: Uses MJCF keyframe 0 (robot start pose on BIOBUZZ field)

imu.source: MuJoCo body quaternion + freejoint angular velocity
imu.note: Simulator extension — not a calibrated IMU

webcam.note: Simulator extension — synthetic AprilTags, no real CV. FOV = rectangular frustum from Logitech Brio 4K presets.

camera.orientationNote: landscape (standaard, mount.rollDeg 0) = camera liggend aan de voorkant, ftcPose X = rechts, Y = vooruit langs de lens, Z = omhoog. portrait = 90 deg om de lens gedraaid (rollDeg 90); de 'Portret'-checkbox naast de FOV-keuze zet dat per browser aan.

mount.note: robot_up_cam pose in the robot frame (x forward, y left, z up from the robot body origin, ~0.044 m above the mat; lens height above mat = z + 0.044). pitchDeg = optical axis above horizontal, rollDeg = rotation about the optical axis (0 = landscape). Default (front shooter + rear POLLEN intake, no POLLEN vision): landscape at the front (x 0.24), lens 16.5 cm above the mat, +35 deg, 90 deg preset, 640x480 (66 x 52 deg H x V): the upward red CELL tags are in view from both tip-line shooting spots (~1.1 m in front of the CELL) and both red clusters from the middle check at (-1.45, 0) in either HIVE state (scratch geometry check in the real scene). Floor POLLEN are not in view (not needed: no yellow-ball detection).

camera.note: Diagonal FOV presets (Logi Tune / G HUB). 640x480 = 4:3 center crop of the 16:9 sensor (vertical FOV kept): 90° → 66.3° x 52.2° (H x V). Derived in src/mujoco/robotCamera.js.

rearMount.note: robot_rear_cam (Webcam 2): rear, landscape, looking backwards (yawDeg 180) and 32 deg down (raised/tilted up to look farther); lens 28.4 cm above the mat at x -0.18 (just in front of the rear POLLEN intake). Same Brio 4K preset as the front: at 90 deg (66 x 52 deg) the floor from ~18 cm to ~2.7 m behind the lens is in view (top edge ~6 deg below the horizon). Used for ColorBlob (yellow POLLEN) detection; AprilTags stay on the front camera.

intakeLayoutNote: rearPollen = shooter aan de voorkant (shooter_muzzle, schiet in de rijrichting), intake alleen voor gele POLLEN aan de achterkant (nectar_intake_site); opgepakte POLLEN gaat direct naar de shooter-hopper. Geen voor-intake, geen NECTAR-inname. 'front' = oude indeling (POLLEN voor, NECTAR+POLLEN achter).

webcam2.note: Simulator extension - rear floor camera for yellow POLLEN (ColorBlobLocator). Same Brio 4K model/presets as Webcam 1.
